---
title: "Correctness and Traceback"
---

## Core Question

Why does the recurrence actually find an optimum?

## Lesson Scaffold

- State the optimal-substructure claim.
- Give a proof sketch for the Needleman-Wunsch recurrence.
- Define traceback pointers.
- Discuss ties and multiple optimal alignments.
- Justify $\mathcal{O}(nm)$ time and memory.

## Notes To Draft

Use a small example where two tracebacks tie so students see that an optimal score need not imply a unique alignment.
